title: pvSuperquadric
body:
## pvSuperquadric

Creates a superquadric surface with normals and texture coordinates: one family covering ellipsoids, rounded boxes, cylinders and tori, chosen by the ThetaRoundness and PhiRoundness exponents (1 = round, near 0 = square-edged, above 1 = pinched). With Toroidal true (the ParaView default) it is a torus-like ring whose hole size is set by Thickness. Use it for test geometry or glyph shapes.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- ParaView's default is a torus (Toroidal true), unlike VTK's own default; set Toroidal false for an ellipsoid-like solid.
- Size and Thickness are shape coefficients, so the overall extent is not exactly Size.
- Schemaxis generates this source from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for it, so inspect the output before relying on it.

Native constructor: `Superquadric`. Identity: `sources/SuperquadricSource`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Center` | This property specifies the 3D coordinates of the center of the superquadric. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `PhiResolution` | The value of this property represents the number of divisions in the phi (latitudinal) direction. This number will be rounded to the nearest multiple of 4. | `{"maximum":1024,"minimum":4,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `4` |
| `PhiRoundness` | This property defines the roundness in the phi (latitudinal) direction. A value of 0 represents a rectangular shape, a value of 1 represents a circular shape, and values greater than 1 produce higher order shapes. | `{"minimum":0.01,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.01` |
| `Scale` | The three values in this property are used to scale the superquadric in X, Y, and Z. The surface normals will be computed correctly even with anisotropic scaling. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `Size` | The value of this property represents the isotropic size of the superquadric. Note that both the Size and Thickness properties control coefficients of superquadric generation, so the value of this property may not exactly describe the size of the superquadric. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `ThetaResolution` | The value of this property represents the number of divisions in the theta (longitudinal) direction. This value will be rounded to the nearest multiple of 8. | `{"maximum":1024,"minimum":8,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `8` |
| `ThetaRoundness` | This property defines the roundness of the superquadric in the theta (longitudinal) direction. A value of 0 represents a rectangular shape, a value of 1 represents a circular shape, and values greater than 1 produce higher order shapes. | `{"minimum":0.01,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.01` |
| `Thickness` | If the value of the Toroidal property is 1, this value represents the thickness of the superquadric as a value between 0 and 1. A value close to 0 leads to a thin object with a large hole, and a value near 1 leads to a thick object with a very small hole. Changing the thickness does not change the outer radius of the superquadric. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0001,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0001` |
| `Toroidal` | If the value of this property is 0, the generated superquadric will not contain a hole (i.e., the superquadric will be ellipsoidal). Otherwise, a toroidal object is generated. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
